resources.string: Set it up once, then tap the app icon to lock your screen.
Tap the app icon on your home screen to lock.
Enable the accessibility service so the app can perform the system lock action.
1. Enable the Simple Screen Lock accessibility service.\n2. Return home and tap the app icon to lock.\n3. Long-press the app icon and choose Settings to return here.

Simple Screen Lock only uses its accessibility service to perform the system screen lock action. It does not read screen content, monitor actions, collect data, or send data. The app does not request internet access.
Locks the screen from the app icon or Quick Settings tile
This service is only used to perform the system screen lock action. It does not read screen content or collect data.
Quick Settings tile was not added
Swipe down twice from the top of the screen, tap Edit, then drag “Lock screen” into the Quick Settings area.
The lock service is unavailable. Re-enable accessibility access.
